# Subject Guides at American University Library

> A comprehensive LibApps-powered resource discovery platform offering subject-specific guides, database directories, and research tools for American University students and researchers.

American University Library maintains this subject guides portal to help students navigate academic research across disciplines. The platform integrates access to major database providers including EBSCO, Gale Cengage, Clarivate, and specialized collections from Accessible Archives and Adam Matthew, while connecting users with subject librarians for personalized research support.

## Core Navigation & Discovery

- [Home - Subject Guides at American University](https://subjectguides.library.american.edu): Homepage for American University Library's subject guides directory powered by LibApps.
- [A-Z Databases](https://subjectguides.library.american.edu/az/databases): Comprehensive A-Z directory of academic databases including Accessible Archives and Adam Matthew.
- [Profiles - Subject Guides at American University](https://subjectguides.library.american.edu/prf.php): Directory of librarian profiles at American University for subject-specific guidance.

## Subject-Specific Guides

- [Wharton Research Data Service](https://subjectguides.library.american.edu/wrds): Guide to accessing Wharton Research Data Service with authentication and account setup instructions.
- [Finding Data and Statistics](https://subjectguides.library.american.edu/stats-data): Guide for locating numeric data and statistics for research across disciplines.
- [Government and Political Science](https://subjectguides.library.american.edu/govt): Subject guide for Government and Political Science research resources and updates.

## Course & Program Resources

- [ECON 480 Resource Guide](https://subjectguides.library.american.edu/econ480): Course-specific resource guide for ECON 480 with data warehouses and research tools.
- [Personal Finance Resources](https://subjectguides.library.american.edu/personalfinance): Subject guide on personal finance covering budgeting, investing, and financial literacy.
